name: Five candidate factors in fixed15 RankIC portfolio

formulas.DIVIDEND_TTM: Tushare daily_basic.dv_ttm / 100, latest snapshot <= signal, age <=7 calendar days; no repricing or zero filling; vendor definition restricts both ex date and reporting period to last12 months
formulas.LOW_ACCRUALS: -(annual consolidated n_income - same-period operating cashflow n_cashflow_act) / ((year-end assets + exact preceding-year assets)/2); nonfinancial companies only
formulas.LOW_ASSET_GROWTH: -(annual year-end assets / exact preceding-year assets - 1); nonfinancial companies only; conservative investment hypothesis, NOT high growth preference
formulas.GROSS_PROFIT_ASSETS: (annual revenue - annual operating cost) / same year-end assets; nonfinancial companies only
formulas.MOMENTUM_12_1: adjusted P[t-21]/P[t-252]-1; >=90% valid prices in253-session window, endpoints/current quote required

financial_asof: report_type1 only; annual Dec31; max(ann_date,f_ann_date) strictly before signal; latest known version per report; conflicts become missing; latest known asset year anchors all financial factors, no fallback to older complete annual reports; exact prior annual assets; max report age730 days
preprocessing: existing 1%-99% industry zscore with small-industry global fallback; preserve missing data for IC; neutral zero ONLY for new-factor portfolio scoring after standardization; no universe removal in primary arms
weights: same252 matured daily5-session RankIC, min120, positive mean capped20%, max5pp monthly change, same first-weekly-of-month updates. Initialize original13 prior and zero new weights; warm2011. Recompute full weight vector separately for each inclusion arm; no fixed blend; old dailyIC remains sealed original evidence
common_control: COMMON arms restrict ranking to identical all-five-raw-valid names each signal; reuse respective BASE/ALL5 full-pool learned weights and score standardization before filtering; isolates selection coverage without claiming pure alpha. Primary arms retain original fixed-score-valid pool; new missing scores neutral. Common pool may be empty after long holidays with stale dividend snapshots: apply original underfill rule, zero names means cash target, no stale-data exception or invented names
unchanged: fixed15, top100, original industry/theme/correlation caps, held-top30 buffer, daily target-vol risk budget, next-close fractional sell-first execution
labels: signal+1 close entry, signal+6 close exit, outcome_end strictly before weight update; overlapping daily labels are not independent
decision: Retrospective diagnostic only; do not select winner as live default or alter paper ledgers. Five single additions plus joint addition; weekly and monthly; all costs and subperiods reported.
limitations: Vendor revised snapshots are not immutable financial vintages
Dividend null can mean no dividend or unavailable; never asserted zero
Weekly dividend snapshots are deliberately stale on other dates
Annual financial factors not TTM; financial industry marked missing, not excluded in primary arms
All years already observed in prior research, not fresh OOS
No causal attribution of total performance change to isolated new alpha: adding factors also reallocates old weights
